sections.title: Biological Data Science II: Data Mining Principles for Epigenomics
sections.description: This course will teach upper level undergraduates and graduate students how to answer biological questions by harnessing the wealth of genomic and epigenomic data sets generated by high-throughput sequencing technologies. Graduate students or permission of the instructor
